recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, airbrushed 1970s-style illustration depicting a group of surfers and a classic hot rod on a beach, framed by a large triangular pennant containing stylized typography. The scene features soft, hazy gradients, palm tree silhouettes against a sunset sky, and a mix of foreground and background figures creating a sense of depth.
coreVisualRelationships: The large pennant flag acts as a graphic header, containing the primary and secondary text.
The central hot rod car serves as the mid-ground focal point, flanked by surfers.
The foreground surfboards and a partially buried head create a playful, surreal entry point for the viewer.
The palm tree silhouettes and horizon line establish a classic California beach setting.
coreInvariants: Airbrushed texture with soft, diffused highlights.
Triangular pennant shape as a framing device for text.
Warm, saturated color palette reflecting a sunset atmosphere.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five men and a car occupy the center and lower two-thirds of the frame; a large pennant dominates the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark blue hot rod with orange flame decals in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large text in the pennant, moves down to the central car and figures, then sweeps across the foreground surfboards.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures, objects, and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sandy browns for the beach and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue for the car and the upper sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red and yellow for the pennant, surfboards, and car flames.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (pennant, boards) contrasting with the softer, airbrushed values of the figures and background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-looking colors; stick to a printed 1970s ink aesthetic.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif and expressive script.
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick, blocky, rounded glyphs with a slight perspective warp to fit the pennant.
Secondary text uses a jagged, lightning-bolt inspired script with sharp angles.
Tertiary text uses a casual, hand-drawn cursive.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the main title has a distinctive top-heavy curve.
The script text features elongated terminals that mimic electrical sparks.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, jagged script paired with heavy, stable block lettering for maximum visual impact.

preserve: The contrast between blocky and script styles

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Burbank Big Condensed or similar heavy rounded sans
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the weight and friendly roundness of the main title.
Matches the jagged, energetic feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An airbrushed illustration of a 1950s beach scene at sunset. A dark blue hot rod with orange flames is parked on the sand. Five men in swim trunks and short-sleeved shirts are posed around the car and surfboards. Palm tree silhouettes are in the background. A large red and yellow triangular pennant flag is positioned at the top, currently empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text inside the pennant. Use a heavy, rounded yellow block font for the main title on the right side, following the pennant's perspective. On the left red section, add a jagged, lightning-style white script and a smaller casual cursive script below it.

verificationChecks: Does the airbrushing have a soft, grainy texture?
Is the pennant the primary container for the text?
Are the palm trees rendered as dark silhouettes against a yellow-to-blue gradient?
Do the surfboards have a glossy, vintage finish?

adjustableVariables: Specific text content in the pennant
mustRedesign: Exact facial likenesses of the figures

mustAchieve: Cohesive integration of graphic and illustrative elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text follows the perspective of the pennant.
Check that the airbrushed highlights on the car look metallic.
Verify the figures have a soft, painted quality rather than photographic.
Confirm the color palette is dominated by warm yellows, oranges, and deep blues.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large geometric graphic container (like a pennant or shield) with a detailed, airbrushed narrative scene featuring vintage automotive and subculture elements, using high-contrast, hand-drawn typography to anchor the composition.
